title: Artificial Intelligence
description: Photonic neural networks and narrow AI. Unlocks the Neural Synthesizer.

puzzle.goal: A neural network outputs raw scores z for each class; they are turned into probabilities by exponentiating and normalising over all classes. Training compares these probabilities with the true labels y (1 for the correct class, 0 otherwise). Write the loss as minus the label-weighted logarithm of the predicted probabilities, summed over classes.
puzzle.name: Cross-entropy loss of a softmax classifier
puzzle.form: - sumk ( k , y _ k * ln ( exp ( z _ k ) / sumk ( j , exp ( z _ j ) ) ) )
puzzle.expr: - ln ( exp ( z1 ) / ( exp ( z1 ) + exp ( z2 ) + exp ( z3 ) ) )
puzzle.ask: Class 1 is the correct one (y1 = 1, the others 0). Find the loss for the three scores below.

vars.j: class index of the normalising sum

puzzle.method: Turn scores into probabilities by exponentiating and dividing by the total; then take minus the logarithm of the probability given to each true label.
